About

I advise business owners on Bitcoin as a treasury strategy, and I am building the standard the profession is missing.

What I do now

Bitcoin treasury advisory

Future-Proofing CEOs. Bitcoin for the treasury. AI for the judgment.

My name is Ricky Saif. My paid work is corporate bitcoin treasury policy and execution setup: I advise business owners, and the CFOs and advisors who serve them, on holding Bitcoin in a company treasury. I have had a paying client since mid-2026.

If you are reading this to decide whether I am safe to let near your company's cash, that is the right question to be asking. The advisory page states who the work is for, what it costs, and how it starts, so you can judge it before you speak to me.

What I am building

The professional standard

The Bitcoin consulting profession is missing two things: a way to prove you actually know Bitcoin, and a way to learn to advise a corporate treasury. I'm building one of each.

Bitcoinstitution

Mine. I own it together with angel investors. It is an on-site proctored multiple-choice certification of hard Bitcoin knowledge, and it is live and bookable today. It exists so that "I know Bitcoin" can be tested by someone other than the person saying it.

Bitcoinstitution

Bitcoin Treasury Academy

Not mine. Bitcoin Treasury Academy is owned 100% by AmityAge. They commissioned me to build their Bitcoin treasury curriculum, and it ships under their brand, not mine. The format is self-paced, with the oral exam retained. It is in production.

Bitcoin Treasury Academy

Where I came from

Thirteen years advising organizations through change

I have advised companies for thirteen years, working with organizations going through change, and I have written two books. Both are listed on the writing page alongside my essays.

That is a different subject from a company treasury, and I offer it as a credential rather than as Bitcoin expertise: thirteen years of advisory work, and two books you can read before you decide anything.

I host the monthly Bitcoin Indonesia community meetup in Jakarta, more than 30 of them so far, and I have spoken at Bitcoin conferences.
